guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at Step 6/16 where it attempts to download the Mambaforge installer script from https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Mambaforge-Linux-x86_64.sh. The wget command follows the redirect to a versioned URL https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/download/26.9.4-2/Mambaforge-Linux-x86_64.sh but encounters a 404 Not Found error. This indicates that the URL or version is no longer valid or available. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to use a valid and current download URL for the Mambaforge installer. You can: 1) Manually verify the latest available release URL from the official Miniforge or Mambaforge GitHub releases page, or 2) Avoid using the generic `latest` URL which may be unstable, and instead specify a fixed version known to be available. After updating the URL, re-run the build to ensure the installer downloads and installs successfully. This fix is required to enable successful environment setup required for running tests.
